(C) The quail is the leftmost

   - The quail is to the left of the robin, so the raven must be to the right of the quail.

- The quail is the leftmost bird.
- The robin is the second from the left.
- The raven is to the right of the quail.

(A) The robin is the leftmost - This is incorrect because the quail is the leftmost bird.
